verses.1: Unto the end. For those who will be changed: of David.
verses.2: Save me, O God, for the waters have entered, even to my soul.
verses.3: I have become stuck in a deep quagmire, and there is no firm footing. I have arrived at the height of the sea, and a tempest has overwhelmed me.
verses.4: I have endured hardships, while crying out. My jaws have become hoarse; my eyes have failed. Meanwhile, I hope in my God.
verses.5: Those who hate me without cause have been multiplied beyond the hairs of my head. My enemies, who persecuted me unjustly, have been strengthened. Then I was required to pay for what I did not take.
verses.6: O God, you know my foolishness, and my offenses have not been hidden from you.
verses.7: Let those who wait for you, O Lord, the Lord of hosts, not be shamed in me. Let those who seek you, O God of Israel, not be confounded over me.
verses.8: For because of you, I have endured reproach; confusion has covered my face.
verses.9: I have become a stranger to my brothers and a sojourner to the sons of my mother.
verses.10: For zeal for your house has consumed me, and the reproaches of those who reproached you have fallen upon me.
verses.11: And I covered my soul with fasting, and it has become a reproach to me.
verses.12: And I put on a haircloth as my garment, and I became a parable to them.
verses.13: Those who sat at the gate spoke against me, and those who drank wine made me their song.
verses.14: But as for me, truly, my prayer is to you, O Lord. This time has pleased you well, O God. In the multitude of your mercy, in the truth of your salvation, hear me.
verses.15: Rescue me from the quagmire, so that I may not become trapped. Free me from those who hate me and from deep waters.
verses.16: Do not allow the tempest of water to submerge me, nor the deep to absorb me. And do not allow the well to close in on me.
verses.17: Hear me, O Lord, for your mercy is kind. Look upon me, according to the fullness of your compassion.
verses.18: And do not turn your face away from your servant, for I am in trouble: heed me quickly.
verses.19: Attend to my soul, and free it. Rescue me, because of my enemies.
verses.20: You know my reproach, and my confusion, and my reverence.
verses.21: All those who trouble me are in your sight; my heart has anticipated reproach and misery. And I sought for one who might grieve together with me, but there was no one, and for one who might console me, and I found no one.
verses.22: And they gave me gall for my food. And in my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.
verses.23: Let their table be a snare before them, and a retribution, and a scandal.
verses.24: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they may not see, and may their back always be crooked.
verses.25: Pour out your indignation upon them, and may the fury of your anger take hold of them.
verses.26: May their dwelling place be deserted, and may there be no one who dwells in their tabernacles.
verses.27: For they persecuted whomever you struck. And they have added to the grief of my wounds.
verses.28: Assign an iniquity upon their iniquity, and may they not enter into your justice.
verses.29: Delete them from the Book of the Living, and let them not be written down with the just.
verses.30: I am poor and sorrowful, but your salvation, O God, has taken me up.
verses.31: I will praise the name of God with a canticle, and I will magnify him with praise.
verses.32: And it will please God more than a new calf producing horns and hoofs.
verses.33: Let the poor see and rejoice. Seek God, and your soul will live.
verses.34: For the Lord has heard the poor, and he has not despised his prisoners.
verses.35: Let the heavens and the earth praise him: the sea, and everything that crawls in it.
verses.36: For God will save Zion, and the cities of Judah will be built up. And they will dwell there, and they will acquire it by inheritance.
verses.37: And the offspring of his servants will possess it; and those who love his name will dwell in it. [ Psalm 69 ] (70)
